content.title: UK's Compass plans to boost India headcount as GCCs drive growth
content.summary: (Reuters) -Compass Group, the world's largest caterer, plans to boost its India workforce by up to 75% over the next three years as it adds more clients, including global capability centres, an executive told Reuters.  The UK-based company, which employs about 40,000 people in India across functions including food catering and facilities services, aims to double its India revenue every three years, said Vikas Chawla, managing director and CEO of Compass Group India.
